name: linux-service-start
title: Start a stopped enabled service
description: Starts one systemd service that is enabled at boot but not running (systemctl start). Units that are not enabled, and anything that is not a .service, are refused.
measure: props=$(systemctl show -p ActiveState -p Result -p Type -p RemainAfterExit -p ExecMainStartTimestampMonotonic -p ExecMainStatus -- "$unit" 2>/dev/null)
if [ "$enabled" != enabled ]; then arh_blocker "Only services enabled at boot are started here; $unit is ${enabled:-unknown}"; fi
# a one-shot is done only when it ran since boot and exited 0: systemd starts every unit with Result=success, and reset-failed sets it back
if [ "$state" = active ]; then arh_plan false "Already running"

elif [ "$type" = oneshot ] && [ "$remain" = no ] && [ "$state" = inactive ] && [ "$result" = success ] && [ "${ran:-0}" != 0 ] && [ "$code" = 0 ]; then arh_plan false "Ran and finished (a one-shot service)"
